meeting.title: Quick catch-up
action_items: Send the SSO troubleshooting guide today
meeting.notes: Ad-hoc call, no calendar invite. Two analysts hit a redirect error when signing in via SSO this morning.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Thanks for jumping on quickly. Two of our analysts got a redirect error signing in this morning.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Both via SSO, or one on password login?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Both SSO. Everyone else got in fine, which is the confusing part.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: That usually means those two are missing the app assignment in your identity provider rather than anything on our side.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Ah — they did both join the data team this month. That would fit.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Almost certainly it. I'll send you our SSO troubleshooting guide today — page two shows exactly where the assignment lives.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Great, I'll forward it to IT. Second thing, very quick: the training session next month, can we bring a few extra people?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Maybe four or five from the ops side. Nothing confirmed yet, they're still deciding.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: That's fine capacity-wise. Let me know once they decide and we'll size the workshop accordingly.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Will do. That was everything — appreciate the fast turnaround.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: No problem, guide is on its way today.
